evals.prompt: This branch adds a new checkout-coupon feature (lots of new Vue components under assets/checkout/). Bug hunt it: run until you find 3 bugs or 1 hour passes. The dev site is at https://app.test:4443 and there's a seeded user doc in docs/seed-users.md. Playwright MCP is available.
evals.expected_output: A structured report with per-bug LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH impact scores, minimized repro steps, screenshot paths captured at confirmation time, a ruled-out section, and a running memory file updated during the hunt.

evals.prompt: qa the icon-upload feature on this branch before we ship friday. i mostly care about real user-facing breakage, not lint stuff. use the browser to actually verify anything you think is broken. cap it at 2 hours.

evals.prompt: Poke holes in the new admin billing-credits UI (branch 014-billing-credits). Stop at 5 confirmed bugs. If something looks broken in code but you can't reproduce it in the browser or via curl/DB, don't count it.
